structural_change: ONE QB bank master placed four times (owner 10-14 09:15): ot_s81_pq_qb_bank{0..3}_native differed ONLY in the write-bank compare constant B ({w[3],w[0]} == B); RTL otherwise, outline 142.56x86.4, 905-pin file, macro placement, recipe and kit were byte-identical. The head now registers per-bank write enables wq0/wq1[3:0] and 7-bit write rows wr0/wr1 on the same edge as the former w0/w1/wv (as it already does for reads rq0/rq1), so the bank master carries no constant, strap or tie-off. Bit-exact, 0 cycles. New masters ot_s81_pq_qb_bankx_native / ot_s81_pq_qb_headw_native (rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/pq/ot_s81_pq_qb_one_native.sv, OT_PQ_QB_ONE_BANK); the four closed bank views and the closed head stand until these close.
